purpose: The code that decides whether two values AGREE. safe_aggregation versions the code that turns readings into totals and never covered this, so a refusal added in audit/compare.py could change a verdict while every published hash stayed put.
boundary: Files that can change a MATCH into a MISMATCH or a NOT_COMPARABLE. compare.py decides; numeric.py parses the values it decides on; value_components.py decides which parts of a value are believed. The aggregation executor is deliberately NOT here — it has its own identity, and one file belonging to two hashes would make each of them a claim about the other.

versioning.patch: wording and logging only; proven not to move any pair between labels
versioning.minor: a new refusal, or a comparison that can now decide what it previously could not
versioning.rule: If the set of pairs landing in match / mismatch / not_comparable can change, it is at least MINOR

why_1_0_0: The first identity for this code. It is 1.0.0 rather than a number continuing the aggregation series because it is not that series: the two are separate identities from here, and pretending otherwise is what let a comparator change ride on an aggregation version.
